theorem lg_target {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] [AddCommGroup H] [PartialOrder H] [IsOrderedAddMonoid H] {f : G → H} (h₁ : ∀ (x : G), f (-x) = -f x) (h₂ : MonotoneOn f (Set.Ici 0)) : Monotone f := by
  intro x y
  cases' le_total x y with hxy hyx
  · exact h₂ x y hxy
  · have : -y ≤ 0 := neg_le_neg hyx
    have : -y ∈ Set.Ici 0 := by
      rw [Set.Ici]
      exact ⟨le_refl 0, this⟩
    have : -x ∈ Set.Ici 0 := by
      rw [Set.Ici]
      exact ⟨le_refl 0, le_trans (le_neg_self y) (le_trans (le_neg_self x) (le_trans (le_neg_self y) (le_trans (le_neg_self x) (le_refl 0))))⟩
    have hf : f (-y) ≤ f (-x) := h₂ (-y) (-x) (le_trans (le_neg_self y) (le_trans (le_neg_self x) (le_refl 0)))
    rw [h₁ y, h₁ x, hf]
    exact le_antisymm (le_trans (le_neg_self y) (le_trans (le_neg_self x) (le_refl 0))) (le_trans (le_neg_self x) (le_trans (le_neg_self y) (le_refl 0)))
